101.notes:
CLKEST collects observation files from CLB cluster files.
All listed observation files are merged into a unique selection.
The merged list is written to OBSFIL.SEL and used for processing.
CLKEST is then executed with this combined observation set.
Requires PARAM1 defining the CLB file pattern.

104.notes:
MPRXTR summarizes results of parallel MAUPRP runs.
Bad observation files are identified and deleted automatically.
Corresponding CZ files are removed together with PZ files.
Processing logs and summary tables are updated accordingly.
104.output:
MPR$YSS+0.SUM (Station summary)
MPS$YSS+0.SUM (Satellite summary)
MPR$YSS+0.DEL (File deletion list)

130.notes:
This script runs residual screening (RESRMS) followed by station quality checking (RESCHK). Stations exceeding RMS thresholds or flagged as bad are removed. Iterative processing is supported up to a maximum number of iterations.

Maximum RMS threshold is derived from FLG files if available. Falls back to default RMS = 1000 mm if no FLG is found

140.notes: This script determines a residual threshold from FLG files and appliesit to the RESRMS processing. Observations exceeding the threshold are flagged and removed accordingly.

150.notes:
Iteratively lower threshold for observation screening
Exisitng FLG-filesname defines threshold for next iteration.

160.notes: Identifies stations with degraded receiver clock performance by analysing the SIG file from a previous processing step. It flags stations whose quality metric exceeds a defined threshold and marks them as “bad clocks”. It then reads the SOS weighting file and replaces the standard station weights for these flagged stations with a fixed downweighting value (CODE = 20.0). The modified SOS file is rewritten.
